text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "Since this date, all persons have the right to access official documents from the Federal Administration, provided there are no predominant public or private interests related to the disclosure of the document that prevent this.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "On 1 July 2006 the Federal Act on Freedom of Information in the Administration (Freedom of Information Act) came into force."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Ce droit s’applique indépendamment de la nationalité et du domicile du demandeur.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Aux termes de cette loi, toute personne a le droit de consulter des documents officiels de l’administration fédérale, dès lors que des intérêts publics ou privés prépondérants ne s’y opposent pas."}]}
